$comment: Server module layers, lowest first. platform sits below layer 1; the composition roots (apps/server/src/*.ts, apps/server/src/scripts/) sit above the last layer. A module imports only the index.ts of a module in a lower layer, or of a module in its own layer when sameLayerEdges names the pair. Read by eslint.config.js and apps/server/src/modules/layers.test.ts. Rules: docs/code-patterns.md § Layers and borders.

sameLayerEdges.why: Organization settings changes write their audit row in the same transaction.
Connecting a mailbox inserts its default settings; the mailbox views read the settings.
The triage worker writes the planned actions in its transaction.
The triage worker creates delegations and detects a delegate's reply.
The chaser plans reminder actions; the service closes reminder sends.
The digest job and /status build the digest text from reports.

rootDeepImportExceptions.why: E2E test seed: writes a mailbox, its credentials and its inbox folder with the mail repository.
E2E test seed: writes an inbox folder with the mail repository.
